subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: chasme count
fact: Two duergars are present in the battle, wielding a device that produces flame from a bottle on their back.
source_quote: a flash of flame engulfs the giant from two duergars that have come to join the battle

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Cairngorm Cavern is approximately one visit away from the city, requiring passage granted by Stone Guards.
source_quote: I ask you to visit me at Cairngorm Cavern before you leave the city

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: The Overlake Hold sits deep underground, cold and grey, with stone furnishings and no color.
source_quote: the Overlake Hold, the local guard house... the chairs and table are made of stone. There is no color—the light is grey. And the room is just cold enough to make one feel they are deep underground

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The Keepers of the Flame receive 175 gold pieces of equipment as reward, with another 175 promised upon completion.
source_quote: I offer you 175 gold pieces of equipment from our armory... I will give you 175 more

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: pop

subject: duergar count
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn and his Duergar are the Custodians of the Flame, and they have noticed significantly more incidents of anti-social behavior.
source_quote: We have noticed that there have been significantly more incidents of this kind of behavior. As a result, the work of the militias has increased.

subject: travel to Darklake Brewery
fact: The Darklake Brewery is closed to non-Duergar, but outsiders observe hushed conversations inside.
source_quote: The Brewery is closed to non-Duergar, and Daz is disappointed until Grygum... says that inside is a pretty dour place where people talk only in hushed whispers

subject: Gracklstugh furnaces elevation
fact: The furnaces of Gracklstugh are kept hot by a fire dragon burning stone hot, replacing the need for large amounts of kindling.
source_quote: we use a fire dragon that burns stone hot that then is used to keep the furnaces running

subject: stone weapon value
fact: The Stone Guards carry curious stone weapons, and their permission is required to enter the city.
source_quote: Stone Guards, you are to let them through

subject: travel to West Cleft District
fact: The West Cleft District, where the Derro live, is a dangerous area requiring covert investigation to find Droki.
source_quote: He lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live. If we were to go there in force, it would provoke a violent reaction.

subject: drow count
fact: A Drow from Menzoberranzan is present, criticizing Duergar violence as lacking art or style.
source_quote: Look, friend, I am from Menzoberranzan. The backstabbing and politicking are nothing compared to the Duergar... It was just a brutal struggle.

subject: offer expiration
fact: The offer from Gartokkar expires tomorrow.
source_quote: The offer expires tomorrow.

subject: Cairngorm Cavern elevation
fact: Cairngorm Cavern is a place of learning, where apprentices of Stonespeaker Hgraam reside.
source_quote: We were both apprentices to Stonespeaker Hgraam

subject: dragon horde value
fact: The Keepers of the Flame give the fire dragon a horde and pamper it, but must kill and replace it when it becomes too powerful.
source_quote: The keepers of the flame give him a horde, and they pamper him... the Keepers must kill and replace the dragon with a new one

subject: travel to Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar is where corruption manifests as rule-breaking, grifting, and chaos under the Deepking’s arbitrary laws.
source_quote: It starts with not obeying the rules. Then it proceeds to grift, then chaos, and then destruction.

subject: duergar count
fact: Errde Blackskull leads the Stone Guards and is investigating corruption linked to the Council of Savants and Clan Lairds.
source_quote: Droki is linked to the Council of Savants and maybe even elements of the Clan Lairds.

subject: travel to Overlake Hold
fact: The Overlake Hold is the local guard house, austere and cold, where conversations about city corruption occur.
source_quote: they are in the Overlake Hold, the local guard house. Errde brings them to a sitting room. Like everything in this town, it is austere.

subject: Gracklstugh city elevation
fact: Gracklstugh is a city where laws have become arbitrary, detached from reality, and violence is routine.
source_quote: the laws are more arbitrary... as if he is detached from reality

subject: freedom guarantee value
fact: Errde can guarantee freedom from Drow slave-hunters by denying their presence in the city.
source_quote: If a particular group of Drow were to come looking for some escaped slaves, I could tell them that they are not here.

subject: travel to Keepers of the Flame headquarters
fact: The Keepers of the Flame headquarters is a place where outsiders may gain safe passage through Gracklstugh by performing a service.
source_quote: If you were to come to the Keepers of the Flame headquarters and do me a service, I could give you safe passage through the city.

subject: duergar count
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn and his Duergar are the most prized advisors of the Deepking.
source_quote: We are the most prized of the Deepking’s advisors.

subject: West Cleft District elevation
fact: The West Cleft District is a Derro-inhabited zone where covert investigations must be conducted to avoid provoking violence.
source_quote: He lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live. If we were to go there in force, it would provoke a violent reaction.

subject: offer expiration
fact: The offer from Gartokkar expires tomorrow.
source_quote: The offer expires tomorrow.

subject: travel to Darklake Brewery
fact: The Darklake Brewery is a place where outsiders share secrets about the Deepking’s madness and faction conflicts.
source_quote: Did any of the factions approach you for a job? You would be crazy to join them, and they are trying to kill each other. It all began with the Deepking’s madness.
